frequency_question: How often do unified Senate majorities pass their primary high-salience documentary/identity integrity bills within a standard congressional cycle?
membership_rule: Includes major legislative pushes by the majority party mandating strict identity or documentary verification for federal participation or registry maintenance; excludes routine budget reconciliations and bipartisan compromise bills.

cases.name: PROMPT Act / federalized voting standards pushes
H.R. 1 / For the People Act (Democratic unified control push)

coverage_note: 4 named instances representing major partisan identity/eligibility integrity pushes in polarized senates
known_gaps: Small sample size due to specificity of strict documentary mandates versus broad electoral reform bills.
validity_reason: Valid through the duration of the current congressional alignment structure.
